units.source_text: "快到了！再坚持一会见！"我心想，

en.t: "It is almost here! Hold on just a little longer and I will see it!" I thought,

units.source_text: "我内心世界同外界之间的这生了锈的锁头，将要被巧妙地打开，

en.t: "This rusted lock between my inner world and the outside world is about to be skillfully opened,

units.source_text: 成为内界与外界的通风口，风可以自由自在地从这里吹拂过去。

en.t: becoming a vent between the inner world and the outer world, where the wind can blow through freely.

units.source_text: 吊桶轻轻振翅起飞，所有的一切都以广袤原野的姿态展现在眼前，

en.t: The bucket lightly flutters its wings and takes flight, and everything appears before my eyes in the form of a vast plain,

units.source_text: 赛定即将毁灭……这幅情景即将呈现，近在咫尺，随手可及了……"

en.t: Saitei is about to be destroyed... this scene is about to appear, close at hand, almost within reach..."
